fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami and Miami Beach civic affairs, including a petition to appoint a charter board, discussion of Miami Beach elections and candidates, and a warning to voters about Section 17 of a proposed Miami Beach gas franchise allowing assignment to any corporation. Features satirical sketches and columns (including “Miami Life's Little Geraldine” and “Things I'd Like to Know”), notes on tourism and winter visitors (“sun worshippers”), local sports and entertainment coverage (boxing, films and theaters), and advertisements including greyhound racing at the Miami Beach Kennel Club.
